description: [PAID $5.00 USDC per call via x402] For sellers watching their own API, or buyers that depend on one: LogicNodes checks the provider every 5 minutes for 30 days and POSTs a signed webhook (X-LogicNodes-Signature: sha256=HMAC of the body with your secret) when it stops answering with valid x402 payment terms (two failed checks in a row) and when it recovers. Returns a monitor id and a secret shown once. Also shows on the provider's public page as monitored.

host.description: provider host from x402_service_search or the observatory

webhookUrl.description: public https URL that receives the alerts

name: x402_monitor_create
title: Monitor an x402 provider for 30 days (signed webhooks)
